# Accredian (accredian.com)




> Accredian is India's leading career-focused online education platform, delivering executive and professional certificate programs in partnership with India's top institutions — IIM Visakhapatnam, IIT Guwahati (E&ICT Academy), IIT Kanpur (E&ICT Academy), XLRI Jamshedpur, SP Jain School of Global Management, IIM Tiruchirappalli, and IIM Amritsar. Programs span Data Science, AI/GenAI, Product Management, Project Management, CXO Leadership, Business Analytics, HR Leadership, Senior Management, Strategy & Leadership, and General Management.




## Important Notice
- Program availability, fees, start dates, and curriculum are subject to change. Please visit [accredian.com](https://accredian.com) for the latest and most accurate information.
- Some programs listed below may have closed for new registrations after their enrollment deadline. Always verify current enrollment status on the website.
- For enrollment queries, contact Accredian's admissions team via the website.




## About Accredian
- Website: https://accredian.com
- Headquarters: Gurgaon, India
- Model: Career-focused online education with curriculum co-creation (not a pure OPM intermediary)
- Mode: 100% Online | Live Instructor-Led | Weekend Classes
- Career Support: Placement assistance, 1:1 career mentorship, resume building, interview prep
- Referral Program: https://accredian.com/referandearn




## Partner Institutions
- IIM Visakhapatnam (IIMV) — Premier IIM; largest program portfolio with Accredian
- E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati (IITG) — Extensive Data Science, Product Management, and Fintech programs
- E&ICT Academy, IIT Kanpur (IITK) — Project Management and AI programs
- XLRI Jamshedpur — HR Leadership, General Management, and Senior Management programs
- SP Jain School of Global Management — GenAI, HR, and Project Management programs
- IIM Tiruchirappalli (IIM Trichy) — CTO Program
- IIM Amritsar — AI for Leaders program
- IIM Lucknow (IIML) — General Management program
